interface.signature: def countOfSubstrings(S: str, K: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and all(c.islower() for c in S) and isinstance(K, int) and 1 <= K <= len(S)
preconditions.description: S is a non-empty string of lowercase alphabets, and K is an integer satisfying 1 ≤ K ≤ |S|.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(S) - K + 1) if len(set(S[i:i+K])) == K - 1)
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of all substrings of S of length K that contain exactly K-1 distinct characters.
